messages.content: Reprice the Sacramento trip end to end. Confirm the hotel is Tuesday and Wednesday nights, make sure the car can be returned after the counter closes, and check that I can finish the Roseville visit Thursday without cutting it short. If all of that still works, book the flight, hotel, and car.

I’ll verify the live totals and terms before placing anything. I have the Tuesday 6:35 p.m. ORD-SMF nonstop, Thursday 6:20 p.m. SMF-ORD nonstop, the Courtyard Roseville Galleria Mall for Tuesday check-in through Thursday checkout, and the airport rental. Is that the set you want repriced, rather than the Hyatt and Enterprise fallback?
Yes, use the Courtyard arrangement. Keep the Wednesday downtown parking and estimated fuel in the trip total even though those are not prepaid.

The flights are still available at $618 round trip, including taxes. Tuesday departs ORD at 6:35 p.m. and arrives SMF at 9:05 p.m. Thursday departs SMF at 6:20 p.m. and arrives ORD at 12:15 a.m. The fare is nonrefundable, but the unused ticket value can be applied to a future flight subject to the fare rules. No schedule change since the last check.
Good. What changed on the hotel?

The same Courtyard room is available for two nights: check-in Tuesday after 3:00 p.m., checkout Thursday by noon. The total remains $363.46 including estimated room tax, and self-parking is free. The change is the cancellation deadline: free cancellation now ends at 11:59 p.m. local hotel time three days before Tuesday arrival. After that, the penalty is one night plus tax. The earlier, more flexible deadline is no longer offered at this price.
That’s acceptable. Verify the rental carefully, especially Thursday evening.

Alamo now has a compact car for $204.62 including taxes and airport fees, $7.14 above the prior rental quote. Pickup is at SMF after the Tuesday flight. The airport return lane operates 24 hours even when the staffed counter is closed: follow signs to Rental Car Return, park in an Alamo space, record fuel and mileage, leave the contract in the car, and place the keys in the marked drop box by the return booth. The rental remains cancellable without charge before pickup. Estimated fuel is still $29.
And the Thursday timing from Roseville? I need the full visit, not a token stop followed by a rush to the airport.

The workable schedule is: finish the Roseville visit at 4:00 p.m., leave by 4:10, allow about 40 to 50 minutes to SMF in typical Thursday traffic, and target the rental return at 5:00 to 5:05. Allow 10 minutes for the after-hours steps and shuttle, reaching the terminal around 5:25. That leaves about 55 minutes before the 6:20 departure. A 5:20 airport arrival is the practical latest limit; if traffic is already above 55 minutes at 4:10, leave immediately and skip any fuel stop by accepting the rental refueling charge.
So give me the complete number before you charge anything.

Booked components total $1,186.08: $618 airfare, $363.46 hotel, and $204.62 rental. Adding the unbooked $20 Wednesday downtown parking and $29 estimated fuel gives a full trip estimate of $1,235.08 before meals, tolls, or any optional rental refueling charge. The flight is nonrefundable with reusable ticket value; the hotel has free cancellation only through 11:59 p.m. local time three days before arrival; the car has no cancellation fee before pickup.
Proceed with all three using the traveler and payment details already on file.

All three are confirmed. Round-trip flight confirmation: S6K9TR, $618. Courtyard Roseville Galleria Mall confirmation: CY-519384, Tuesday check-in through Thursday checkout for two nights, $363.46, free parking, with free cancellation through 11:59 p.m. local time three days before arrival. Alamo compact-car confirmation: AL-728541, $204.62, cancellable without charge before pickup, with the 24-hour return lane and key drop available Thursday. Booked total is $1,186.08; estimated trip total is $1,235.08 after $20 downtown parking and $29 fuel. Thursday: finish at 4:00 p.m., leave Roseville by 4:10, target the rental return by 5:05, and treat 5:20 as the latest terminal arrival.
